shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui .claude

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C3 "dashboard\|grid-layout\|charts" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/* 2>/dev/null | head -60
npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30

npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit @gravity-ui/icons 2>&1 | tail -8; for p in dashkit icons uikit; do echo $p $(node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json').version"); done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/*/docs 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit && wc -l build/docs/INDEX.md README.md && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; ls build/docs
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs && sed -n 150,420p INDEX.md
sed -n 420,536p INDEX.md; cd /home/sandbox/workspace; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 "styles\|import '@gravity" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | sed -n 1,60p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit && grep -n -i "css\|scss\|style" README.md | head -15; ls build/esm | head -30; cat package.json | grep -n '"exports"' -A25 | head -40; sed -n 1,200p build/esm/index.d.ts; ls build/esm/plugins build/esm/shared/types 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && wc -l .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && grep -n "^#" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && sed -n 35,50p ../../package.json; cat components/index.d.ts; cat components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; cat shared/types/plugin.d.ts; cat shared/types/config.d.ts | head -90; cat plugins/index.d.ts; ls components/*
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 53,150p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && cat components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts typings/plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150; ls typings; grep -n "interface Settings\b" -A25 typings/*.d.ts | head -50; grep -n "SetConfigItem\|AddNewItemOptions" -A12 typings/*.d.ts | head -50; cat components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts; grep -n "ItemDropProps" -B2 -A10 shared/types/*.d.ts | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules && sed -n 1,9p @gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/config.d.ts; cat @gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/index.d.ts | head -20; ls @gravity-ui/icons/ | head; for i in ChartColumn ChartLine Pencil Check Xmark TextAlignLeft Heading Plus TrashBin Layout; do ls @gravity-ui/icons/esm/$i.js 2>/dev/null; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install @gravity-ui/charts 2>&1 | grep -i "err\|peer" | head; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>/dev/null; wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs/INDEX.md; grep -n -i "required setup\|^## \|ThemeProvider\|height" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && grep -n "MenuItems" -B2 -A12 typings/common.d.ts | head -40; grep -rn "Delete\|removeItem" components/DashKit/DashKit.js components/GridItem/GridItem.js components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js | head -20; cd /home/sandbox/workspace; git status --short; grep -n dashkit package.json

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Progress Label Checkbox Flex Text 2>&1 | head -40; grep -n "ItemState\b" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types/state-and-params.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.d.ts | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Progress/types.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "theme\|view\|size" Label/Label.d.ts | head; grep -n "variant" Text/Text.d.ts Text/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n "content\|onUpdate\|checked" Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head; grep -n "TextInput\|placeholder" -m3 controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -3
cat .gitignore; git status --short
rm -rf dist && git status --short | grep dist
